system.description:
In the years before the war, due to the prevalence of directed energy weapons, the typical forms of combat armor were normally made of hard polymer plates over a heat-resistant, electrically-insulated flexible bodysuit. This armor, while bulky and sometimes cumbersome, provides excellent protection against most weapons; someone wearing it is often assumed to be a person looking for trouble.

Tech Level 3 Combat Armor is Armor which provides Protection of 4. Tech Level 4 Combat Armor provides Protection 5 instead. In either case, this Protection is reduced to half (rounding up) by attacks with the breaker keyword. The armor is bulky and scary.
